audience: online sellers who take card payments and refunds through Omise

useCases.title: Review failed payments and their codes
useCases.text: List charges, newest first, and open one to read its amount, status, card and failure code.

useCases.title: Check the balance and the account
useCases.text: Read the account balance with its total, transferable and reserve amounts. Read the account behind the key.

useCases.title: Follow up on disputes
useCases.text: List the disputes, newest first, and open one to read its amount, reason and due date.

useCases.title: Refund a charge
useCases.text: Read a charge and its earlier refunds. Then create a refund. A refund is final and cannot be more than the refundable balance.

useCases.title: Capture an authorized charge
useCases.text: Capture an authorized charge to move the money to the account. Omit the amount to capture the full authorized amount.
